title: I made a dumb little browser game where you play Rockstar's legal team fighting off a leaker
author: HitGameMaker
selftext:
With the leaks that keep dropping I had a stupid idea and actually built it: **Stop The Leek** \- a free browser game where you're Rockstar's legal department and a hooded guy with a leek for a head keeps reaching for the LEAK button to dump the build.

You click his mechanical arms to fire DMCA takedowns before they reach the button. Three leaks get through and it's over.

* Armored arms take 3 hits (labeled "NDA", obviously)
* Combo chains build a GTA-style wanted level multiplier
* Boss waves where five arms come at once
* There's a 30-second BLITZ mode if you just want chaos
* Global leaderboard for damages prevented

No install, no signup, works on mobile. Made it in a couple of days as a joke and it turned out weirdly fun.

👉 [https://cyberleek.base44.app](https://cyberleek.base44.app/)

Obviously a parody — not affiliated with Rockstar or Take-Two in any way, no real leaked material in it, all fictional. Just a dumb bit.

comments.author: bmanley620
comments.body: Just tried it out. I was very impressed with the graphics and like the quirky idea but the gameplay was rather tedious. I just kept tapping like an inch to the right of the leek and kept winning. Have you considered implementing a punishment system where if you tap somewhere that isn’t on a target the difficulty ramps up?

replies.author: HitGameMaker
replies.body: thanks man, just dropped a fix for this :)
